messages:
andrew: Heads-up — product asked for a lightweight dashboard showing cost per 1k tokens + breakdown for cache & batching savings. Want to stitch runtime + infra inputs. Who owns signals and a rough ingestion contract?

maya: I can own the dashboard UX/console side. Need exact metric names and cardinalities.

zhan: Runtime can emit: `model, route, org_id, seq_len, tokens_generated, kv_cache_hits, batch_size` as aggregates. Prefer low-cardinality buckets for seq_len and batch_size.

sam: Agree on buckets. Also we should expose an estimated USD cost per 1k tokens field from billing pipeline so the dashboard can compute normalized values without joining raw costs.

lina: Important: quotas team needs route/org dimensions for quota enforcement and cost alerts. Can we add `route_id` and `quota_scope`?

zhan: yes to route_id. quota_scope probably computed downstream, but runtime can add `route_id` and `customer_tier` labels.

andrew: Minimal ingestion contract suggestion (low-cardinality):
```json
{
  "metric": "tokens_emitted",
  "labels": ["model","route_id","org_id","customer_tier"],
  "buckets": {"seq_len_bucket": "<50|50-200|200-1k|>1k","batch_size_bucket": "1|2-8|9-32|>32"},
  "aggregates": ["tokens","kv_cache_hit_tokens","kv_cache_miss_tokens","requests"]
}
```

oliver: That looks doable. Runtime will emit aggregates every 10s. Question: sampling for high-volume customers?

zhan: We should allow per-org sample_rate override. Default 1.0 for paid, 0.05 for free tier. Keep full counts in runtime so we can extrapolate — include `sample_rate` field.

maya: On the console side we want: cost per 1k token (rolling 1h/24h), cache savings (%) and token-savings waterfall (prefix cache, KV, batching). UX: small sparkline + one-line delta.

sam: Quota/alert hooks: add `cost_per_1k_est_usd` from billing joiner as an ingest field, and an `estimated_monthly_burn` TTL snapshot. Alerts can then be per-route or org.

lina: For rollouts UX — can we attach model-variant and fallback-policy labels so the dashboard can show canary impact on cost?

zhan: add `model_variant` and `fallback_policy` with constrained enums. No freeform strings to avoid cardinality explosion.

andrew: Nice. Who's round-tripping PO review and infra SLA? I can drive a short RFC for ownership.

maya: I'll mock the console panels next week and link here.

oliver: Runtime PR: I'll add the new aggregate event and `sample_rate` field. ETA 5 days.

sam: Billing joiner will expose `cost_per_1k_est_usd` via the metrics pipeline — I'll allocate quota for this ingestion.

infra-bot: [deploy] metric-pump v0.9 deployed to staging (test with `--metric-test client=redwood-qa`).

andrew: Great — next steps: zhan+oliver implement, sam wires billing joiner, maya prototypes dashboard. I'll draft ownership in #product to lock SLA. Ping me if blockers. :thumbsup:
